title: Zellij Configuration Race Condition During Parallel Claude Code Instances
body:
**Bug Description**
When running 5 Claude Code instances simultaneously with zellij, the global config is intermittently reset/initialized.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: ghostty
- Version: 1.0.31
- Feedback ID: e9630e69-538d-4020-bc61-6575df8069b0
